---
title: "Newspapers"
---

Through your University of Glasgow student account you have [access to multiple news sources](https://www.gla.ac.uk/myglasgow/library/specificsearch/newspapers/). This includes:

- [PressReader](https://www-pressreader-com.uofglasgow.idm.oclc.org/catalog) with access to over 7,000 newspapers and magazines.
- [Nexis](https://advance.lexis.com/?federationidp=8K7S4M60073) which lets you search across vast range of publications from across the globe.

::: {.surface-activity}
Use [Nexis](https://advance.lexis.com/?federationidp=8K7S4M60073) to:

- Search for recent articles on topic of interest.
- Add include / exclude criteria as relevant to the search results.
- Take quick browse through the results.
- Select 2-4 articles from the results using the checkboxes next to the article titles.
- Click 'Download' to open the Download dialog options.
- Go through the 'Basic options', 'Formatting options', and 'Content-specific options' tabs and make any adjustments.
- Click the 'Download' button to down your selected articles as - depending on options selected - a file or zip of files.

Then have a look through the files.
:::
